answer: Session keys rotate only after a signed work receipt, so a stolen key cannot submit a second identity's task, and the new key binds to that receipt's nonce and dies at epoch close. Failure mode we hit: two clones sharing one key submitted in the same block, the panel voided for non-diversity, and both lost the epoch. Concrete case: 40 sable-rated identities on the mesa batch, all voided because every key rotation traced back to the same vertex operator.
